title: Chasecall: keep a task that must be chased between sessions
description: Chasecall is a Claude Code plugin for a task that has to be chased - a refund, a booking, an unanswered request. It keeps the task between sessions: it writes the next letter, counts the attempts, brings the person one brief a day, and asks them to step in for the call or the payment. No keys, no accounts, nothing sent without the person's yes.
